question: Are uncertainty and statistical support reported?

check.procedure: Auditor search of the extracted SWE-bench paper text (52 pages) for confidence interval, standard error, standard deviation, variance, seed, bootstrap, and statistical; reading of both OpenAI posts for reported uncertainty.
check.detection_limits: A text search can miss uncertainty shown only in figures or in material not saved; the leaderboard was not read.

reasons: The sources report percentages resolved without intervals, standard errors, or repeated runs, and the 2024 post states its scaffold results come from a single seed. Nothing contradicts the concern; the evidence is missing, so the proposed state is Insufficient evidence (stored as Undocumented). The benchmark sources report no check of uncertainty, so the check outcome is not_performed.

instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.
